## Checklist

- [ ] `composer check` passes (style, static analysis, catalog lint, tests)

If this adds or changes a template:

- [ ] It is its own design, not an existing bundle in different colours
- [ ] No horizontal scroll or clipping at 320, 375, 480 and 600px
- [ ] Light and dark schemes both check out, including buttons and logos
- [ ] AA contrast in both schemes
- [ ] The text part reads properly
- [ ] Any third-party asset in the sample data is credited in `credits`
